tei:div.tei:p: theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi rtsa tshig bzhugs so// dpal bkra shis rin po che myur du bde ba chen po dang ldan par mdzad pa don thams cad grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po sngon 'gro dag la bslab/ /dngos gzhi gtong len spel mar sbyang / /yul gsum dug gsum dge rtsa gsum/ /rjes kyi man ngag mdor bsdus pa'o/ /len pa'i go rim rang nas brtsams/ /de gnyis rlung la bskyon par bya/ /man ngag snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /spyod lam kun tu tshig gis sbyangs/ /'phral la gang thub bsgom du sbyar/ /gnyis po tshang na thams cad blangs/ /bkol ba rnams la rtag tu bsgom/ /le lan thams cad gcig la gda'/ /kun la bka' drin che bar bsgom/ /dka' ba gsum la bslab par bya/ /thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis/ /nyams pa med pa rnam gsum bsgom/ /spyi don gsum la rtag tu bslab/ /'dun pa bsgyur la rang sor bzhag /rgyu yi gtso bo rnam gsum blangs/ /stobs lnga dag la sbyang bar bya/ /chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus/ /dpang po gnyis kyis gtso bor bzung / /yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du bsten/ /yengs kyang thub na 'byongs pa yin/ /shags ngan ma bgod/ yus ma bsgom/ ko long ma bsdam/ 'or che ma 'dod/ yud tsam pa mi bya/ 'phrang ma dgug mdzo khal glang la mi 'byo/ 'gyogs kyi rtse ma gtod/ gzhung bzang po ma bsten/ go log mi bya/ res 'jog mi bya/ lto log mi bya/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyi mthar bya/ dol chod du bya/ 'bral med gsum dang ldan par bya/ /rnal 'byor thams cad gcig gis bya/ /log na de nyid gnyen por bsgom/ /gnyis po gang byung bzod par bya/ /yan lag nyams pa brjod mi bya/ /gzhan phyogs gang yang mi bsam mo/ /lha bdud du mi dbab/ skyid kyi yan lag tu sdug ma tshol/ rkyen gzhan dag la ltos mi bya/ gtso bo ngos bzung / 'bras bu re ba thams cad spangs/ dug can gyi zas spang / gnad nas mi bskul/ snyigs ma lnga po bdo ba 'di/

/byang chub lam du bsgyur ba yin/ /brtan pa thob nas gsang ba bstan/ /man ngag snying po gdams pa 'di/ /dam pa dag las brgyud pa yin/ /rtsa ba'i tshig go /jo bos mdzad pa yin no// //shu bhaṃ// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a ti sha/ theg chen blo sbyong rtsa tshig/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
